title: Xavier was great.. wonderful tour!
text: Xavier was an outstanding tour guide! Very knowledgeable about the city, food and wine selection. We especially enjoyed the various food selections and the fresh calamari and cava!
author: davidsyring

title: Xavi knows his tapas
text: Honestly came for the food and stayed for the stories. Xavi was hilarious and so knowledgeable — he explained the difference between tapas bars, bodegas, and tabernas and made us feel like locals by the end of the night. Thank you so much!
author: Y8685UIlus

title: Best Host in Barcelona
text: Xavi has this incredible energy — he's part guide, part storyteller, part sommelier. He explained every wine, every dish, and every neighborhood anecdote with equal enthusiasm. Genuinely one of the best evenings I've had traveling.
author: Meander06697536531

title: Best way to spend an evening
text: We were a group of four and tour tour guide tailored the whole experience to us — our pace, our preferences, our questions. The food was amazing but the real value is the insider knowledge you walk away with
author: hernanalba9

title: Gracia is a gem and this tour proves it
text: We had no idea this neighborhood existed before this tour. Xavi was our guide and he was so passionate about local food culture — he knew the owners of every spot, explained the history behind each dish. Loved it.
author: IgnacioS849
